messages:
maya: customer reported sudden failures on function/tool calls after last runtime deploy. root symptoms: some requests get 400 schema validation errors, others get 401 auth for the same endpoint. customer says their production traffic started failing ~30m after deploy. repro steps provided.

samir: can you paste the exact payload + error? also which model/runtime? we'll need logs.

maya: repro (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/tools/invoke
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
{
  "tool": "weather.get",
  "args": {"city":"NYC","units":"si"}
}
```
response: 400 {"error":"schema_validation","details":"invalid enum value for args.units: \"si\""}
and occasional 401: {"error":"unauthorized","message":"Invalid token"} from same customer IPs.
Customer severity: P1 (transactions failing).

jen: CI is also failing on the toolcall golden suite - job: https://ci.redwood.internal/job/5234 (failing since the last runtime build). failing test: tools/e2e/golden_toolcalls::weather_integration. log excerpt:
```
AssertionError: expected 'metric' in enum ['imperial','standard']
at tests/tools/golden_toolcalls.py:88
```
looks like enum set changed in schema.

alex: fyi I merged a small mapping change in the model-adapter yesterday (PR #4127) that renamed some enum values to align with upstream model tokenizer (metric -> standard, si -> metric). might be the cause. the adapter now translates incoming client args to internal names, but I might have inverted the mapping for legacy callers.

leo: we're also seeing a latency spike around the same time as deploy: grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/serving/latency?from=now-60m shows p95 jumping from 180ms -> 1.9s and p99 to 4.2s. that coincides with increased retries from the client side which could explain the intermittent 401s/timeouts.

qa-bot: CI artifact: https://ci.redwood.internal/artifacts/5234/failed_logs.zip (contains request/response samples and stack traces). failing count: 9/12 runs since build 202.

billing-bot: flag: increased retry volume from the customer has inflated token usage by ~12% in last hour. might hit their billing quota.

samir: immediate plan: 1) roll back the adapter mapping to previous behavior (hotfix) — low-risk patch. 2) add compatibility layer to accept both old/new enum labels for 48h. 3) add CI regression that POSTs both enum variants to avoid future drift. can take ownership of 1 & 2.

alex: I can open the rollback PR now and add migration mapping in runtime. will include a feature flag for compatibility. linking draft: https://git.redwood/pulls/4189 (WIP).

jen: QA will add a golden prompt that exercises tool arg permutations + an enum-mismatch test to the CI suite. I'll add tests to flaky-goldens and gate them on the e2e job.

maya: customer update: told them we're investigating and will push a hotfix. they want ETA. can we give 1-2 hours?

samir: should be able to hotfix and deploy to canary in ~45 mins, full rollout in ~2h if metrics look good. will monitor auth failures.

leo: I'll keep an eye on latency and enable a temporary stricter autoscale rule to absorb retries. also will add an alert for 5xx/error-rate > 0.5% for this customer tag.

billing-bot: created ticket BILL-987 for potential invoice adjustments if we end up crediting the customer.

maya: thanks team. can someone post the final rollback commit & canary link here once done? :pray:

alex: rolled back mapping in PR 4189, merged to hotfix branch. canary deploy started: https://deploy.redwood.internal/canary/202. watching logs.

jen: CI re-run after hotfix shows golden toolcall tests passing locally. pushing to CI now.

qa-bot: CI job 5236 triggered, initial run green for the golden_toolcalls suite. artifact: https://ci.redwood.internal/artifacts/5236/passed_summary.txt

leo: latency normalized after canary and autoscale change. p99 back to ~220ms. no new 401 spikes.

maya: customer notified of hotfix and will validate on their side. requesting to keep compatibility mapping for 48h then plan a migration window.

samir: agreed. follow-ups: (1) add CI regression for enum drift (jen), (2) add telemetry to detect mapping mismatches automatically (alex + leo), (3) postmortem if needed after stability. assigning owners in the ticket. :white_check_mark:

alex: also adding a small note to the release changelog to avoid surprising customers next time.

maya: closing loop when customer confirms. thanks all :thumbsup:
